user.title: Huawei HiLink Opple Light (cloud)
user.description:
1. On a computer WITH A BROWSER (not necessarily the one hosting Home Assistant): `pip install playwright` then `playwright install chromium` (one-time setup).
2. Copy this file to that computer and run it:
`{helper_path}`
3. A Chromium window opens on the official Huawei login page - log in normally, nothing else to do.
4. The script captures everything automatically and writes `ha_credentials.json` to the current folder.
5. Paste the **content** of that file below.

error.invalid_json: Invalid or incomplete JSON - re-run get_credentials.py and paste the full result again.

abort.already_configured: This Huawei account is already configured.
